fields.name: PgConnectionConfiguration connection resolution
fields.contract: PgConnectionConfiguration exposes a PostgreSQL IDataConnection implementation. SetAmbientConfiguration accepts global, shard-set, read/write, and shard property sources; only PgConnectionPropertiesBase inputs participate. GetConnectionString returns one connection string whose non-null properties are applied in order global, shard set, read/write, shard, then local, so a later non-null property overrides an earlier one. ConnectionDescription returns the resolved identity in the form "database {Database} on server {Host}" using the same precedence for database and host.
